description: Atmosphere and flight-state values computed by KSP's own CelestialBody and FlightIntegrator methods. FlightIntegrator is hosted without Unity (fields set: currentMainBody, altitude, spd, sunDot, atmosphereTemperatureOffset, situation) and its real protected methods CalculatePressure() and CalculateConstantsAtmosphere() are invoked; CalculateConstantsAtmosphere is called twice per row because GetSolarAtmosphericEffects reads the density left by the previous physics frame (the second call is the steady state). HighLogic.CurrentGame.Parameters = new GameParameters() (Normal difficulty, ReentryHeatScale = 1).

provenance.float_semantics: IEEE-754 binary32/binary64, SSE2 (RyuJIT x64); libm from the .NET Framework CLR, not Unity's Mono
